rule:
Eligible = not a deep-audit direct competitor (the S8 knock-out). Top 30 = best 15 eligible per track by
round-2 Elo (a short track's gap is filled from the other), ordered by rubric band (S, A, B, then below 65), then Elo:
Elo ranks, the rubric bands. Below-65 ideas are ranked only to reach ~30 and carry below_bar: true
(deviation from PROMPT S11 "drop below 65", logged 2026-09-26: only 11 of 60 finalists cleared 65).

deep_prior_art.note: Live self-report distrust verifiers exist but none confirmed as a second independent agent re-navigating the live portal/target for claims-ops fleets with a signed per-verification fee.
Elder-fraud monitoring exists via cloud account-linking (Carefull, EverSafe); StatementLock parses statements in-browser but isn't elder-specific or fully on-device.
Both help with Medicaid enrollment/renewal but neither audits a filled packet against rejection-trigger rules before submission.
Yoodli already nudges live during real video calls with replay analytics; Poised does live in-call coaching too. Same mechanism and niche.
Open-source 'System 1 reflex layer' implementations already sit directly on/beside Jev, judging every event with a fast model and escalating to a slower one.
TMS tools auto-generate rate cons from structured load data, but none teach themselves a lane/carrier's format from one hand-built example as this idea proposes.

finalists.name: Screen API for Legacy PM Systems

deep_prior_art.note: Funded companies already turn legacy PM/EHR screens into agent-callable automation for billing/RCM using computer-use workers; metered endpoint is a business-model variant, not a new mechanism.

finalists.name: Stop the Wire Before It Sends

deep_prior_art.note: Enterprise AP bank-detail-change screening is mature; SMB no-finance-team niche unclaimed.
Questionnaire auto-answer tools exist but use API integrations for security teams, not a browser agent logging in as the SMB owner.
Live tools already read a real codebase and turn an incoming ticket/request into a grounded effort/impact estimate; client-feature-request framing is a thin wrapper on an existing mechanism.

competitors: CallSphere AI voice agents for prior authorization (https://callsphere.ai/blog/ai-voice-agents-prior-authorization-payer-phone-automation)
deep_prior_art.note: Crowded prior-auth AI space, but none found do live, quote-cited real-time transcription of the P2P call itself into a structured appeal file the moment it ends.
Filler removers cover sync/filler cleanup; ElevenLabs Voice Changer transfers expressive delivery but needs a performed reference take, not auto monotone-to-lively conversion.
Local/offline legal LLM setups exist, but none packaged as case-folder-to-motion-draft matching firm templates, zero-network, at solo-lawyer pricing.
Smart Moving already sells a rotate/tilt stairwell-and-doorway clearance solver to moving companies, same niche and mechanism.

finalists.name: Client Quote Estimator for Dev Shops

deep_prior_art.note: Devtimate quotes from uploaded briefs not a real repo scan; the repo-scanning tools target internal estimation, not client billing quotes.
Cut-based filler removers are common but none re-synthesize full audio in the same voice with an energy lift while forced-aligning timestamps for slide sync.
AI-slop bounty triage pain and reputation gating are already live, but no product uses a refundable per-submission x402 stake with automated-reproduction forfeiture.
General hallucination-highlighters and carrier-side claims automation exist, but none pairs a full claim file with a carrier's AI summary for independent adjuster sign-off review.
Offline/local AI scribes for therapists exist and address privacy; none package the specific per-claim timestamp-citation-and-flag UI, which differentiates the mechanism.
Real-time senior scam-call detection exists but none confirmed to target AI voice-clone family-emergency calls with proxy alerts.

competitors: Ropes & Gray AI Court Order Tracker
deep_prior_art.note: Standing-order trackers and citation checkers exist separately; no combined per-filing video briefing found.
Citation-hallucination checking is a crowded live category, but none found are distributed by malpractice-insurance brokers, run on-prem, or surface only an aggregate risk score to underwriting.
WISP templates and generic compliance-form agents exist, but none combine an AI-drafted WISP interview with a browser agent that auto-files the PTIN portal and insurer attestations.
Krasyn's live, free Note Check tool already flags scribe-note sentences unsupported by the transcript across many vendors; same mechanism and adjacent niche.

competitors: Windows 11 agentic Fix it button, Microsoft (https://www.pcworld.com/article/2773838/an-ai-driven-fix-it-button-is-just-what-windows-needs.html)
deep_prior_art.note: Microsoft is shipping an in-OS agentic Fix it button for Windows 11 Copilot+ PCs matching niche and mechanism closely, though free and bundled rather than paid third-party.
Carefull aggregates financial accounts via linking; Oma Care agentically calls government by phone. No product found that browser-agent-proxies across banks plus Medicaid/Medicare portals.
Virtual mailboxes OCR-scan mail but require redirecting to their facility and don't extract Medicaid renewal deadlines or pre-fill responses.
Fortuna Health matches the consumer Medicaid niche; Skyvern matches the portal-filing-agent mechanism; no product combines OCR-notice capture with autonomous reinstatement filing at signup.
RedactLocal already ships local strip-then-reinsert redaction for lawyers/CPAs sending drafts to cloud AI, same niche and mechanism.
Form/e-signature and one-way announcement consent tools exist; no live multilingual interactive voice-dialogue agent logging a verbal yes was found.
Mature paddle-raise capture category, but incumbents rely on human spotters entering data manually; no live product auto-detects paddles via camera+speech fusion.
Walk-GPS mapping and succession advisory exist separately; no narrated-extraction succession-mapping combo found.
Evidence-then-approve diagnosis exists as single-user local apps; no unified remote-family-approval-plus-undo product found.
TypeSafe's Jev (launched Sept 2026, $40M seed) already ships sub-second, cheap, typed per-event judgments with escalation via a developer SDK, usage-priced — same mechanism and buyer.
Hold-waiting/IVR-navigation call agents are well established, but none are scoped to practice-management vendor support lines or re-verify the fix against real system state before closing.
Live cloud tools check citations in the same niche, but all cloud-hosted; none run fully on-device to preserve privilege.

competitors: Elastic Security Labs internal AI triage (https://www.elastic.co/security-labs/ai-vulnerability-triage-bug-bounty-hackerone)
deep_prior_art.note: AI reproduces reported exploits in a sandbox and returns pass/fail already, but no confirmed packaged air-gapped/on-prem-only product for regulated bounty programs.
Fabricated-citation catching is crowded but all use legal-database APIs, not a vision browser-use agent, and none blocks e-filing submission.
Live product enforces hard session-wide spend cap across multiple x402 merchant calls with receipts, same mechanism as the idea.
GPS field-note apps and AR underground-utility viewers exist separately; none combine narrated oral history, confidence-tagged provenance, and AR playback for farm succession.
Anchor Browser already logs into locked portals like Availity via computer use and exposes reads/writes as MCP tools for any AI client.
Generic AI POA/form-fillers exist but none maintain a bank-certification-form library, flag notarization gaps, and draft statute-citing rebuttal letters.
Manual fit calculators and separate 3D room scanners both exist; none combine automatic full-route video-based 3D reconstruction with a verdict and maneuvering animation at checkout.
DMS continuity niche active but via backend backup/restore, not a computer-use agent mirroring screens.
Cloud scribes push notes only to browser-based EHRs; local GUI agent for legacy desktop EHRs not found.

Agent action-receipt tools are a live category, but all found competitors serve enterprise/commerce-risk or engineering buyers, not consumer daily-money-managers filing redacted Medicaid/Medicare proof.
Incumbents own gala paddle-raise capture via manual/mobile-bidding entry; none found fuse room cameras with live auctioneer speech recognition for automatic vision-based logging.
Trustpair owns vendor bank-change verification live but via automated data checks, not an outbound phone call; matching hackathon prototype exists but isn't live.

AI appeal-letter drafting from a photographed denial is live and common, but none confirmed to autonomously file into the plan's portal and independently re-verify a filing ID; Aegis has that mechanism but for provider-side buyers.
Multilingual multi-currency invoice OCR auto-posting to a ledger is an established live category; mechanism identical, buyer niche narrower.
Bank monitors and call-scam detectors exist separately, but none link a flagged call to a same-day new payee into one combined alert.
Live medical interpreters with exportable bilingual transcripts already ship (Mabel AI, GoSpeech, Aida, Opalite Health); differentiation would need low-resource-language depth.

finalists.name: Scope Gate for Your Own Agent

deep_prior_art.note: Scoped mandate plus pre-action interception exists as dev-infra and payment protocols; no found product packages it as a consumer subscription app for personal agents.
Keito matches the buyer/billing niche but only attributes cost, no live hard-cap; llm0/LiteLLM hard-cap via proxy but are generic dev infra, not matter-rebilling products.
Zonos already offers listing-to-HTS classification, invoice generation and low-value-shipment brokerage filing for small e-commerce sellers post-de-minimis change; same niche and mechanism.
Human vishing sims and AI-agent red-teaming both exist separately; no combined weekly test-fix-retest vendor found.
Live coaching copilots and real-time scam/fraud alerts exist separately; no single tool combines both plus discreet supervisor escalation.

Several shipping AAC apps already listen to the conversation partner and surface AI suggestions, but each generates/predicts new text rather than ranking only the user's own pre-saved, approved phrases.

Mechanism has academic prior art (2008 Converser prototype, not live), but no shipping standalone companion app ranks an imported phrase bank from partner speech; commercial apps predict from the user's own typing.

finalists.name: Live call-verification copilot for payment requests

deep_prior_art.note: Balto matches the live-transcript, private-prompt, escalation mechanism but as general compliance coaching; Pindrop/Rulebase serve same fraud niche via deepfake detection instead.
